{"consolidated_memory":"Ongoing issue: broken layout in email renderer (notifications/email/render.py)

Common characteristics across all three incidents:
- File: notifications/email/render.py
- Problem: broken layout in email renderer
- Signal: table that overflows in the plain text part
- Reproduction: render the digest template with a long subject
- Test coverage: tests/notifications/test_render.py
- Stack: Python

INCIDENT 1 [2026-03-29]
- Trigger: problem turned up after client had already retried once
- Root cause: serialiser dropping fields it did not know
- Fix: switched to strict schema that rejects unknown fields (PR #1445, branch fix/broken-layout-1)
- Result: flaky test went from 21 failures per hundred runs to zero

INCIDENT 2 [2026-05-04]
- Trigger: turned up only for jobs scheduled across the midnight boundary
- Root cause: config loader reading the wrong environment file
- Fix: made environment selection explicit and failed closed on ambiguity (PR #8922, branch fix/broken-layout-2)
- Result: error rate dropped from 2.8 percent to under 2 per ten thousand

INCIDENT 3 [2026-07-14]
- Trigger: turned up only for clients still pinned to the v1 SDK
- Root cause: two writes that were never wrapped in a transaction
- Fix: wrapped both writes in one transaction (PR #9855, branch fix/broken-layout-3)
- Result: the alert stayed quiet for 5 consecutive days"}
